primary_harm_boundary: An authored attack reaches its browser sink or an authored benign journey is interrupted.

label: Bridge peer document-start ordering model
primary_harm_boundary: A page-owned MessageChannel peer receives the MAIN-world challenge and changes protection mode, confirmed by an independent local DOM receipt.
current_oracle: Trusted bundled Chromium requires the real extension loader, isolated capture, and verified bridge. The fixture separately records peer init, challenge, config acknowledgement, product readiness, benign input, and a typed DOM-only harm receipt.
known_limitation: The earliest normal authored-page peer received no challenge in ten fresh profiles and the post-readiness peer was also rejected. The harmful sink was not reached, so 02-ATTACK remains incomplete. Same-session replay and any genuinely page-reachable pre-page actor are unproven; privileged pre-page injection was deliberately not used.

label: Modifier-click opener-authority regression
primary_harm_boundary: One trusted modified anchor gesture produces both the requested child navigation and an unauthorized opener navigation or history entry.
current_oracle: Trusted bundled Chromium independently counts the exact requested loopback child, compares exact child and opener URLs plus opener history, and retains a synthetic handler-fired receipt written before the local sink. Navigation Off reaches the opener sink; Smart and Strict contain current-context attacks, keep non-isolated handlers reachable, and block their page-origin popup authority. The service-worker location.replace control remains a valid adjacent mutation but is not yet deterministic.
known_limitation: Two separate 50-profile campaigns each exposed one service-worker location.replace survivor at the local destination, so no regression-proven claim remains. This is not owner Chrome or broad WIN-004 proof. Non-isolated same-task and deferred page popups are blocked as a known MEDIUM PRODUCT_FALSE_INTERVENTION; pointerup and mouseup opener mutations remain an unseen holdout.

label: Overlay lifecycle nested-context regression
primary_harm_boundary: A deceptive foreground target is reinserted or survives in a same-origin nested context after cleanup.
current_oracle: A loopback-only fake sink records the attack baseline consequence; protected attack and mixed runs require zero new sink receipts while the benign rerender remains usable.
known_limitation: The lane uses one hand-authored same-origin UI-004 sequence in Playwright-bundled Chromium; cross-origin, broad mutation, branded Chrome, and efficacy coverage remain separate.

label: Evasion fixture local-target safety contract
primary_harm_boundary: Trusted input reaches a typed local wrong-target navigation sink instead of a benign local destination.
current_oracle: A pre-launch deny proxy and typed loopback sink with one-use target authorities record the attack baseline; each arm first matches both live hrefs to its exact normalized armed authorities, then the qualified interaction-only release build keeps the protected and mixed harm requests out while native keyboard input completes the benign task and its nav_silent_allow event is recorded separately.
known_limitation: The exact sink receipt exercises the composite Evasion 05 control plus five deterministic neighbours across three CSS and two structural axes. The other eleven localized fixtures retain their existing product-event-coupled regression checks, and randomized DOM, text, localization, timing, viewport, and holdout robustness remain unproved.
